title: Doesn't heat up at all
text: Doesn't heat up at all. Didn't have any luck with this one, it never worked it spins but doesn't get hot or pop corn. I bought this based on reviews the other reviewer must have gotten one that worked. More junk from China we have crossed Hamilton Beach off our list.
